76: newAchievement{
77: 	name = "The True Coward", id = "CULTS_TRUE_COWARD", category = "Forbidden Cults",
78: 	show = "full",
79: 	desc = _t[[Win without having saved Kroshkkur, Derth, the lost merchant, Melinda and lady Aeryn.]],
80: 	mode = "player",
81: }
82: -- Yes addon author that reads this, you can bind hooks in many places ;)
83: class:bindHook("Winner", function(self, data)
84: 	if data.kind ~= "sorcerers" then return end
85: 	local p = game:getPlayer(true)
86: 	-- Kroshkkur is cults only
87: 	if not p:hasQuest("cults+start-cults") then return end
88: 
89: 	-------------------------- Aeryn ------------------------
90: 	-- We are on the end level so we can check that easily
91: 	local aeryn = game.level:findEntity{define_as="HIGH_SUN_PALADIN_AERYN"}
92: 	if aeryn and not aeryn.dead then print("True Coward check: aeryn is alive. FAILED!") return
93: 	else print("True Coward check: aeryn is dead. GOOD!") end
94: 
95: 	-------------------------- Melinda ------------------------
96: 	if p:hasQuest("kryl-feijan-escape") then
97: 		if p:hasQuest("kryl-feijan-escape"):isSuccess() then
98: 			if not p:hasQuest("love-melinda") then
99: 				print("True Coward check: melinda not in love but alive! FAILED!") return
100: 			else
101: 				if p:hasQuest("love-melinda"):isCompleted("death-beach") then
102: 					print("True Coward check: melinda in love but died at the beach! GOOD!")
103: 				else
104: 					print("True Coward check: melinda in love and alive! FAILED!") return
105: 				end
106: 			end
107: 		else
108: 			print("True Coward check: melinda died in the crypt! GOOD!")
109: 		end
110: 	else
111: 		print("True Coward check: melinda died in the crypt (no entered)! GOOD!")
112: 	end
113: 
114: 	-------------------------- Derth ------------------------
115: 	if not p:hasQuest("lightning-overload") then
116: 		print("True Coward check: Derth was never in danger! FAILED (and not possible?)!") return
117: 	else
118: 		if p:hasQuest("lightning-overload"):isSuccess() then
119: 			print("True Coward check: Derth was saved! FAILED!") return
120: 		else
121: 			print("True Coward check: Derth was left to its troubles! GOOD!")
122: 		end
123: 	end
124: 
125: 	-------------------------- Merchant ------------------------
126: 	if p:hasQuest("lost-merchant") then
127: 		if p:hasQuest("lost-merchant"):isCompleted("evil") then
128: 			print("True Coward check: merchant was left to his own fate! GOOD!")
129: 		else
130: 			print("True Coward check: merchant was saved! FAILED!") return
131: 		end
132: 	else
133: 		print("True Coward check: merchant died (no entered)! GOOD!")
134: 	end
135: 
136: 	-------------------------- Kroshkkur ------------------------
137: 	if game.state.cults_kroshkkur_destroyed then
138: 		print("True Coward check: Kroshkkur was left to be destroyed! GOOD!")
139: 	else
140: 		print("True Coward check: Kroshkkur was saved! FAILED!") return
141: 	end
142: 
143: 	-- Ok we are a true coward!
144: 	world:gainAchievement("CULTS_TRUE_COWARD", p)
145: end)

translation_snapshot.source: Win without having saved Kroshkkur, Derth, the lost merchant, Melinda and lady Aeryn.
translation_snapshot.target: 在不拯救克诺什库尔、德斯镇、迷路的商人、梅琳达和艾琳的情况下获得胜利。

translation_snapshot.source: #DARK_SEA_GREEN##{italic}#As you move you suddenly find yourself entrapped in a hidden digestive sack that seems to void all your abilities!#{normal}##LAST#
translation_snapshot.target: #DARK_SEA_GREEN##{italic}#在你向前移动的时候，你突然发现自己掉进了一个隐藏的消化袋里，它似乎让你所有的能力都失效了！#{normal}##LAST#

translation_snapshot.source: This 'armour' seems to mostly consist of chunks of a rune etched stone somehow fused with a highly flexible black mesh. The titanic pieces of stone would undoubtedly deflect any blow thrown at you, but you would need obscene strength just to move while wearing this. The glyphs and runes carved into the chunks sometimes light up of their own accord, letting out small bursts of magic.
translation_snapshot.target: 这块护甲似乎是由一块块刻有符文的石块组成，它们与某种高度灵活的黑色网状物融为一体。毋庸置疑，巨大的石块可以阻挡对你身上的任何打击，但你需要巨大的力量才能穿着它移动。刻在石块上的符文有时候会自动点亮，放出小型的魔法爆炸。

translation_snapshot.source:
It is said that the preferred weapons of the krog is a mace in one hand and a sword in the other. One hand to spread the message of the Zigurath, the other to see that message through to the end.
The sword symbolizes the krogs committment to their task of fighting against the forces of the arcane. With each slash the krog would endevor to continue, until at last their opponents would fall.
translation_snapshot.target:
人们说克罗格首选的武器是一手拿锤、一手拿剑。用一只手传播伊格兰斯的讯息，用另一只手将这一讯息贯彻到底。
剑象征着克罗格坚守着他们对抗奥术力量的任务。每一次挥砍，克罗格都会竭力坚持下去，直到敌人终于倒下。

translation_snapshot.source: #LIGHT_RED#Your %s is too heavy to carry with your punny constitution anymore. You remove it.
translation_snapshot.target: #LIGHT_RED#你的体质已不足以穿戴沉重的%s，你将它卸下了。

translation_snapshot.source: temporarily causes the target to receive entropic backlash from any healing they receive for %d turns up to %d%% of the healing done. This effect scales with your Magic stat.
translation_snapshot.target: 暂时使目标从所受治疗中受到熵能反冲，在 %d 回合内最多受到相当于治疗量 %d%% 的伤害。效果受魔力值加成。

translation_snapshot.source:
It is said that the preferred weapons of the krog is a mace in one hand and a sword in the other. One hand to spread the message of the Zigurath, the other to see that message through to the end.
The mace symbolizes the krogs willingness to endure until the final blow is struck against the arcane. Commonly the mace would be used to batter a mage senseless, thus preventing them from being able to cast their spells.
translation_snapshot.target:
人们说克罗格首选的武器是一手拿锤、一手拿剑。用一只手传播伊格兰斯的讯息，用另一只手将这一讯息贯彻到底。
锤象征着克罗格愿意坚持到向奥术挥出最后一击为止。锤子常被用来把法师打得不省人事，使其无法施法。
